text: oh hey. i just realized also when painting more grass as u investigated, that grass / bushes have a cap :( [Image #3] it cut off right here lmao
resolution: Grass/bush foliage truncated at a hard diagonal wall (req_1291). Root cause found with data: the bake's bush field needs 224,392 clumps but grassPopulation.ts capped MAX_INSTANCES at 80,000 — so bush was cut ~3x (grass was only 42,320, never hit it). A single lush chunk is 14,400 tiles x 26 cards = ~374k, far over 80k. Raised the cap to the GPU static-instance ceiling (framework/gpu/3d.zig MAX_STATIC_INSTANCES = 1,048,576), the buffer the compiled loader plants grass into, so the field never truncates before the hardware does. Switched the allocation from a flat MAX_INSTANCES pre-alloc (would be 50MB upfront + retained behind subarray) to geometric growth from 16k with a right-sized slice() copy on return. Verified: re-bake now plants all 224,392 bush + 42,320 grass (was 80,000 capped), total world instances 126,897 -> 271,429, render proof GREEN. Editor /test still uses the dynamic 65536 path (compiled-first workflow is unaffected). File: cart/hmsc-int/render3d/grassPopulation.ts (uncommitted, interwoven with a parallel session's grass system).
